a_scale.name: Global Cross-Generation Commander Scale
a_scale.formula: weighted sum over D1..D8 where each domain averages all its battlelines across 2.x, 3.x, and 4.x tiers
a_scale.invariant: Weights and battleline denominator remain constant across generations (v0.1.3 -> v4.0) so scores are strictly comparable over time.

b_scale.name: Intra-Generation Core Readiness Scale
b_scale.name_zh: 代内核心战线就绪标尺（b-Scale）
b_scale.formula: weighted sum over D1..D8 restricting each domain average to battlelines with target_generation_major <= active_major
b_scale.invariant: Measures execution completeness of the active generation (30 lines in 2.x; expands to 36 in 3.x and 41 in 4.x).
